_comment: AGENTS.md rule 13: the hook entries .claude/settings.json needs (merged next to the existing ones).
Owner applies them: python .claude/hooks/harness_status.py --write-proposed <file>, check, copy over .claude/settings.json.
Commands run in Git Bash. A missing script exits 0 (fail open, e.g. a fresh clone where .claude/hooks is not checked out).
The inbox command reads runs.json with bash builtins only: while nothing is bound Python never starts (cost = the bash start).

The inbox command finds the task store with bash builtins too: AOP_TASKS_DIR from the environment, else its line in config/aop.local.env (the device's local environment, scripts/tools/local_env.py); neither = no inbox, Python never starts.
launch_gate always exits 0 (it denies through JSON); inbox_hook's exit 2 on SubagentStop is deliberate and passes through exec.

tool_guard (R1 raw image repoint in Blender MCP code, R2 blender_gate.py piped, R3 endless loop in a background Bash / PowerShell or Monitor command, or in a foreground command that detaches: INC-027, INC-037): Python starts only when the input names blender_gate, the Blender tool, run_in_background true, the Monitor tool, nohup / disown / setsid / Start-Job / Start-Process, or (a Bash call) a lone `&`. The input is read with the `read` builtin (no fork, INC-038: `b=$(cat)` cost ~200 ms per call), so a foreground call costs the bash start alone; deny through JSON, exit 0.
turn_end_guard (Stop, INC-027): blocks a turn end once per item while a watch.py watch outlived its job or a process of the session runs an endless loop outside watch.py; always exit 0, fails open.

hooks.command: f="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}/.claude/hooks/tool_guard.py"; [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; b=; IFS= read -r -d '' b; case "$b" in *blender_gate*|*execute_blender_code*|*'"run_in_background":true'*|*'"run_in_background": true'*|*'"tool_name":"Monitor"'*|*'"tool_name": "Monitor"'*|*nohup*|*disown*|*setsid*|*Start-Job*|*Start-ThreadJob*|*Start-Process*) printf '%s' "$b" | python "$f" || true;; *'"tool_name":"Bash"'*|*'"tool_name": "Bash"'*) case "$b" in *[!\&\<\>\|]\&[!\&\>]*) printf '%s' "$b" | python "$f" || true;; esac;; esac; exit 0

p="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; f="$p/.claude/hooks/inbox_hook.py"; t="$AOP_TASKS_DIR"; [ -z "$t" ] && [ -f "$p/config/aop.local.env" ] && while IFS='=' read -r k v || [ -n "$k" ]; do [ "$k" = AOP_TASKS_DIR ] && t=${v%$'\r'}; done < "$p/config/aop.local.env"; r="$t/inbox/runs.json"; b=; [ -n "$t" ] && [ -f "$f" ] && [ -f "$r" ] && IFS= read -r -d '' b < "$r"; case "$b" in *'"'*) exec python "$f";; esac; exit 0
